run_bg_esti — MV tracking op

• Data kinds: table × image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.run_bg_esti(model, image) (to call the implementation directly, import mvtrack; mvtrack.run_bg_esti(model, image); from the registry, opsmv.get("run_bg_esti"))

• HALCON equivalent: run_bg_esti (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Update the background with one image and return the foreground region.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

背景との差の絶対値が threshold を超える画素を前景にする。入力の model は書き換えず、更新後のモデルを model の鍵で返す。空の入力(image が 0 要素)は ValueError。

Args:

model: create_bg_esti の返り。

image: 現在の画像(モデルと同じ形)。

Returns:

model(更新後)と foreground(bool 配列)を持つ dict。
